correctness.rationale: Writing \(r=\beta_2/\beta_1\), the source-series term magnitude is \(a_n=\Gamma(1+nr,1)/n!\). Fixed-cutoff incomplete-gamma asymptotics plus Stirling give \(\log a_n=(r-1)n\log n+n(r\log r-r+1)+O(\log n)\), so terms grow for \(r>1\). At \(r=1\), the exact integer incomplete-gamma formula gives \(a_n\to1\). For \(0<r<1\), absolute termwise integration follows from integrability of \(t^{\beta_1-1}e^{-t^{\beta_1}+t^{\beta_2}}\). Continuity then gives the exact complementary repair. The packaged checker independently verifies representative direct integrals and both convergence regimes.
